hero_sub: A hands-on, case-study-driven program where you learn Product Management the way real product teams practice it — from discovery to strategy, delivery, launch and growth — then walk away with a portfolio-ready product case study.
hero_pills: Built On A Live Capstone Product
how_headline: Built like a real product team — every single week.
how_sub: This isn't a lecture series. Every week follows the same rhythm real product teams use: prepare, work the case, apply it to your own capstone product, get feedback.

steps.title: Pre-Read Sent
steps.desc: Reading material for the week is sent ahead of class, so you walk in already familiar with the topic.

steps.title: Live Case Study
steps.desc: The live class works through a real-world product case study built around that week's topic — not just theory.

steps.title: Build On Your Capstone
steps.desc: Every week you apply what you learned to your own product, building a portfolio-ready case study as the program progresses.

steps.title: Direct Access
steps.desc: Mentorship access to your facilitator throughout the program — for questions between classes too.

phases.title: Discover
phases.desc: Where every product professional has to start — understanding users, discovering real problems, and defining a product vision and strategy worth building.

phases.title: Build
phases.desc: Where it becomes real — solution discovery, MVPs, writing PRDs and user stories, and delivering with Agile, Scrum and stakeholder management.

phases.title: Launch, Measure & Grow
phases.desc: The skills teams actually pay for — roadmaps, go-to-market, product metrics, growth, monetization, and leading products through ambiguity.

weeks.title: Product Management Foundations
bullets: What Product Management actually is, and what a PM does day to day
Product Manager vs Project Manager vs Program Manager
Product thinking: outcomes over outputs, and customer-centric decisions

weeks.title: Users, Customers & Product Discovery
weeks.application: APPLICATION: DESIGN A USER RESEARCH EXERCISE
bullets: User vs customer, segments, personas & the 80/20 rule
Qualitative & quantitative research: interviews, surveys & observation
Turning customer feedback into validated product insight

weeks.title: Problem Discovery, Validation & Market Analysis
weeks.application: APPLICATION: VALIDATE A REAL PRODUCT PROBLEM
bullets: Framing problem statements & separating symptoms from root problems
Validating assumptions with evidence, not opinion
Market & competitive research, and assessing real opportunity

weeks.title: Product Vision, Strategy & Business Model
bullets: Product vision vs strategy vs roadmap — and why the difference matters
Value Proposition Canvas & Business Model Canvas
Setting product goals, KPIs & OKRs that connect to business strategy

weeks.title: Solution Discovery, Ideation & MVP
bullets: Moving from problem to solution: ideation, design thinking & validation
What an MVP actually is — and the most common ways teams get it wrong
Designing MVP experiments with clear learning objectives & success criteria

weeks.title: Product Requirements & Product Design
weeks.application: APPLICATION: WRITE A PRD & USER STORIES
bullets: Structuring a PRD that teams can actually build from
Writing user stories, epics & acceptance criteria that hold up under scrutiny
Working with design & engineering: feasibility, trade-offs & ambiguity

weeks.title: Prioritization, Backlog & Product Planning
bullets: Prioritization frameworks: MoSCoW, RICE, Kano & Value vs Complexity
Managing a healthy backlog: epics, features, bugs & technical debt
Release planning around outcomes, not just output

weeks.title: Agile Delivery, Scrum & Stakeholder Management
bullets: Agile principles & Scrum in practice: sprints, ceremonies & roles
Managing delivery risk, scope & technical debt with engineering teams
Stakeholder mapping, negotiation & influencing without authority

weeks.title: Product Roadmaps, Launch & Go-To-Market
weeks.application: APPLICATION: BUILD A ROADMAP & LAUNCH PLAN
bullets: Outcome-based roadmaps vs feature lists — and how to communicate them
Launch planning: readiness, internal & external launch, post-launch review
Go-to-market: positioning, messaging & sales enablement

weeks.title: Product Metrics, Analytics & Experimentation
bullets: North Star metrics, leading vs lagging indicators, avoiding vanity metrics
Funnel metrics: acquisition, activation, retention, churn & NPS
Running A/B tests & experiments that actually change decisions

weeks.title: Product Growth, Monetization & Product-Market Fit
weeks.application: APPLICATION: BUILD A GROWTH & MONETIZATION STRATEGY
bullets: Identifying & measuring real product-market fit
Growth loops, retention strategy & conversion optimization
Monetization models: subscription, freemium, usage-based & value-based pricing

weeks.title: Product Leadership, Career Readiness & Capstone
bullets: Product leadership: decision-making under ambiguity & cross-functional influence
Building a portfolio-ready product case study that shows real thinking
Presenting your complete, end-to-end Product Management capstone

personas.desc: Learn to discover real problems, define strategy and ship products on schedule.

personas.title: Tech & Ops Professionals

personas.title: Anyone Ready To Commit

A prioritized backlog, PRD, roadmap and GTM plan you built yourself
